senses.gloss: f. (שָׁוָה) joined, even; fitting, equal; equivalent, worth.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 19a:6">Succ. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>נראה מבחוץ וש׳ מבפנים</he> if the post is visible from the outside, but even with the wall from within.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:3">Num. R. s. 9<sup>3</sup></cite> <he>הוי ש׳ לבני אדם</he> be like other men (do not consider thyself exempt from the laws of morality).
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 3:9">B. Kam. III, 9</cite> <he>שור ש׳ מנה וכ׳</he> an ox worth a Maneh that gored an ox worth two hundred Zuz.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 1:3">Ib. I, 3</cite> <he>שום כסף וש׳ כסף</he> valuation of damages is done on the basis of money, and collected from money’s worth; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 14b:12">ib. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ כסף מלמד וכ׳</he> ‘money’s worth’, this means that the court attaches only landed estate (v. <cite ref="A01052"><he>אַחֲרָיוּת</he></cite>), but if the claimant anticipating the action of the court seized movable chattel &c.; <he>מאי משמע … דבר הש׳ כל כסף</he> how is this to be learned from the expression ‘money’s worth’?… A thing which is worth any money (which you pay for it, i.e. concerning which there is no redress for overreaching); <cite ref="Bava Kamma 14b:12">ib.</cite> (another defin.) <he>ש׳ כסף ולא כסף</he> ‘money’s worth’ you may attach, but not cash.—<he>ש׳ פרוטה</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01667"><he>פְּרוּטָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bikkurim 2:6">Bicc. II, 6</cite> <he>ש׳ לאילן</he> is like (comes under the category of) trees.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bikkurim 2:8">Ib. 8</cite>, sq.; a. v. fr.—<he>גזרה ש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="C00581"><he>גְּזֵרָה</he></cite>.—<he>הצד הש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="R00078"><he>צַד</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 16:2">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XVI</cite> <he>ש׳ לי המות משתתנני וכ׳</he> death would have been more acceptable to me than thy giving me away to this man, i.e. I should have chosen death rather than be married to this man.—Pl. <he>שָׁוִים</he>; <cite ref="U01470"><he>שָׁוִין</he></cite>; <he>שָׁוִו׳</he>; <cite ref="U00358"><he>שָׁווֹֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 6:1">Yoma VI, 1</cite> <he>מצותן שיהיו שניהן ש׳ וכ׳</he> it is proper that they two be alike in appearance &c.
<cite ref="Beitzah 11a">Bets. 11ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>וש׳ וכ׳</he> both agree that &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 9:10">B. Bath. IX, 10</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Batra 158b">158ᵇ</cite>), a. e. <he>את הש׳</he> that on which they agree, v. <cite ref="H01112"><he>חָלַק</he></cite>.—<he>בַּשָּׁוֶה</he>
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 10:2:3">Y. Keth. X, 33ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>חולקות בש׳</he> divide it equally; a. fr.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: for what it is worth, at a reasonable price.
